nyc.divergence_notes: Same instrument feeds METAR and CLI. ~1°F drift from QC/rounding. Trace precip is NOT > 0 for rain markets.

lax.divergence_notes: CLI location is LAX (CLILAX product = airport), NOT FHM (CLIFHM = downtown LA). KCQT and KBUR are different stations entirely. Verified live 2026-04-07: CLIFHM showed 81/59 while CLILAX showed 78/61 on the same day — 3°F high divergence.

chi_midway.divergence_notes: CRITICAL: Kalshi resolves Chicago on KMDW, NOT KORD. KMDW averages 1-3°F warmer.

mia.divergence_notes: KMIA at the airport, not KMFL or KOPF.

bos.divergence_notes: Coastal; cooler than KBED inland on summer afternoons.

dca.divergence_notes: Reagan National. Do NOT substitute KIAD (Dulles) — runs 3-5°F colder on min temps.

dfw.divergence_notes: KDFW, not KDAL (Love Field). KDAL runs slightly warmer.
